detail.title: 8+4MP 25x TiOC Network Panoramic PTZ Camera
detail.overview: Compare Favourite SDT4E425-8P-GB-A-PV1-SL 8+4MP 25x TiOC Network Panoramic PTZ Camera Key Points • Captures a Large Area and Great Details at the Same Time • High-Quality Imaging with 8MP Resolution for Bullet Channel, 4MP for PTZ Channel • 180° Wide Angle Splicing Image Monitoring • Auto Tracking 3.0：Effective Target Monitoring with Detailed Intruder Trajectories • Active Deterrence: Audible and Visual Alarms Can Be Triggered by Certain Events to Drive Away the Target • IP66 and Anti-Corrosion Design for Reliable Protection Sales Enquiry Datasheet
